pnpm.comment: Controlled audit fix: pin the dev/test-only vite+esbuild (transitive via @vitejs/plugin-react / @vitest/coverage-v8) to patched lines. vite ^6 + esbuild ^0.25 clears the vite path-traversal advisory while staying on Vitest 3.x's supported matrix (Vitest 3 supports Vite 5 & 6; the Vite-6 floor is hard from Vitest 4).
